motion_rule: a full sprint on all fours from the first frame down a bazaar lane at the lens, the camera racing backwards ahead so the stalls and the shoppers tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; the picture fills the vertical frame top to bottom with no bars; head half the frame; new shot size each beat; camera move every beat
character: a lean brown macaque in a grey waistcoat, deadpan, running flat out
second_characters: ONE small macaque porter in a green visor; from 5.05 he hangs off the risen pan and rides up with it
props: ONE brass balance beam with two identical pans, hooked on his tail; two identical brown coconuts, same size and husk, in his waistcoat
prop_continuity: the left pan drags at his knee from 1.0; the right pan rides up from 4.3 and never comes down
environment: a packed bazaar lane, stalls of fruit and brass to the ceiling both sides, shoppers scattering out of his way
light_events: hard noon sun bars strobe his face every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: o-DIN, po-KA-zy-va-et, na-kop-LE-ni-ya, dru-GOY, kar-MI-che-ski-e, DOL-gi
audio.pacing: 0.45-3.55 one breath; the gap under one second; 4.5-7.15 one breath with no voice sound outside the lines; after 7.15 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: his feet hammering the stones all clip, the bazaar roaring, a woody knock at 0.45, a chain slam at 1.0, a rising ring at 4.3

timeline.a: the beam swings into the lens off his tail, pans dead level, he is already at a full sprint
he drops a coconut into the left pan without breaking stride
the left pan slams down and the weight slings him into a harder run
he tears past the loaded pan dragging dead down at his knee
he runs flat out at the lens, the loaded pan swinging under him
he drops the other coconut into the right pan the same way, still running
the right pan flies up past his ear and yanks his tail up, tearing him onto his toes
the risen pan hauls him off his feet and drags him down the lane on his heels
the porter leaps and hangs off the risen pan with his whole weight to drag it down
the pan carries the porter up instead, both rising, he is back on his feet
the risen pan tows him headlong down the lane, the porter swinging on it
he swats the riding coconut and it does not come down, the porter hauling the chain down
he throws a fruit crate onto the risen pan on the run and it takes that up too
he swings the sunk pan past the lens, the risen one overhead with the porter on it
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the sunk pan at his ear and the risen pan overhead

must_appear: two identical coconuts; the first into the left pan at 0.45 drags it down; the same drop into the right pan at 3.55 sends it up at 4.3 and it hauls him off his feet; from 5.05 the porter hangs off the risen pan and it lifts him instead; at 9.4 his deadpan face is in the lens
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal bars, a 16:9 frame, night, dark scene, a walking hero, standing bystanders, a still background, a parked camera, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, the risen pan coming down, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, cyrillic letters, extra limbs
